limitations: Focused 30-case replay does not establish full-corpus parity.
Warnings and SMT coordinates are compared exactly; explanatory coordinate omission is not equality.
Source JVM crashes, timeouts and source API mask HeapSort failures are inconclusive.
Hash equality verifies recorded bytes, not by itself executable build provenance.
Coverage/integrity completion is not a proof of diagnostic or semantic parity.
Timeouts, prover faults, crashes and incomplete sessions remain inconclusive.
A selected isolated retry does not establish successful reuse of its failed initial session.
Warning string equality, solver warning counts and generated coordinates are not normalized.
A source snapshot and binary hashes do not prove binary build provenance.
External imports and dynamic libraries not included in the frozen manifests remain outside the verified inventory.
